Title: New region for MySQL - Single Server in Brazil Southeast

Body.Content: To provide you with the best experience of managed open source database offerings, we are launching preview support of Azure Database for MySQL - Single Server in the Brazil Southeast region. You now have additional flexibility in deploying solutions to help accelerate innovation and better support people working to transform their businesses. Learn more about the current regional availability of Azure database services for MySQL products.
